name: Crate of Grimtotem Horns
summary: The Crate of Grimtotem Horns carries evidence of the Grimtotem Clan in Feralas. Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar wants to hear what you found.

sections.title: News from Feralas
sections.body: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Belgrom Rockmaul receives the Crate of Grimtotem Horns. You found the horns while hunting in Feralas, where the Grimtotem Clan has drawn attention. Belgrom wants to hear what you saw and will pay you for the news.

faq.answer: The crate holds Grimtotem horns taken from Feralas.
Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor wants the Crate of Grimtotem Horns.

faq.q: Why does Belgrom want the horns?
faq.answer: Belgrom wants to hear what you saw of the Grimtotem Clan in Feralas.

faq.q: Where did the horns come from?
faq.answer: You found the Grimtotem horns while hunting in Feralas.
Belgrom says he will count out coin while you tell him about the Grimtotem.
